purpose: Exhaustive closure plan and execution record for Sprint 79 D0/D1 implementation-applicable or benchmark-only theory items.

default_execution_policy.owner: Sprint 79 capability owner; release owner signs final artifact
default_execution_policy.seed: predeclare a stable integer seed in the lane artifact and rerun unchanged
default_execution_policy.sample: use the lane's named dataset/model and held-out split; never substitute a mock for a real-model lane
default_execution_policy.run_record: artifacts/m14/<lane>.run.json (immutable provenance/run record alongside the lane artifact)
default_execution_policy.cleanup: disposable clone/cache/temp files only; retain artifact and manifest; redact secrets
default_execution_policy.waiver: owner-signed scope, rationale, expiry, and non-core/core impact; never waive a core percentage gap
default_execution_policy.security: offline by default, bounded inputs, pinned revisions/licenses, isolated caches, no implicit model download
